THE WAY WE SEE IT

Progress starts
with a different lens.

The best ideas rarely arrive fully formed. We’re interested in the questions that keep you up, the prototypes on your desk, and the future you want to make real.

Rainbow is a venture-studio concept for people who believe building is a conversation. This template gives that conversation a considered place to begin.

BELIEF, WITH WORK BEHIND IT

Small beginnings.
Serious intent.

From the first useful question to something people can hold, use, and care about.

01

See the possibility.

What’s broken? Who feels it? Start with a specific insight, not a bigger pitch deck.

02

Make it tangible.

Turn conviction into a prototype. Put it in someone’s hands. Listen closely.

03

Build with intention.

Find the next useful step. Good partnerships grow through honest feedback and shared work.

BEFORE WE BEGIN

A few good
questions.

How early is too early?

An idea with a clear problem is enough for this introduction. Explain what you have learned and what you would try next.

What should I include?

The problem, the people affected, your approach, and why it matters to you. A thoughtful paragraph beats a perfect deck.

Is this a real funding application?

No. This is a reusable venture-studio template. The form creates a local text draft and does not contact an investor or promise funding.

What happens to my information?

The draft is generated in your browser. Nothing is submitted or stored by a server. Save the downloaded file if you want to keep it.
